notes: Ordered operation chains for the dsp module. Every op is validated before the first sample is touched, and nothing is written unless the whole chain succeeds.

streaming-safe-normalize.label: Streaming music level and peak safety
streaming-safe-normalize.purpose: Reach the streaming loudness target while guaranteeing the true-peak ceiling.

club-loud-normalize.label: Club level and peak safety
club-loud-normalize.purpose: Loud club delivery with a tight ceiling and no clipped runs.

podcast-speech-master.label: Podcast and narration speech master
podcast-speech-master.purpose: Mono speech master: silence trim, rumble filter, level target, peak ceiling, 48 kHz.

broadcast-headroom-transfer.label: Broadcast R128 headroom transfer
broadcast-headroom-transfer.purpose: Programme level at -23 LUFS with a -1 dBTP ceiling at 48 kHz.

cinema-headroom-transfer.label: Cinema print headroom transfer
cinema-headroom-transfer.purpose: Leave theatrical headroom: no loudness lift, peak ceiling at -3 dBTP.

film-stem-headroom.label: Score stem headroom
film-stem-headroom.purpose: Keep stems quiet enough for mix stage work: ceiling -6 dBTP, no level lift.

sfx-cleanup.label: Sound effect library cleanup
sfx-cleanup.purpose: Tighten edges, remove DC and rumble, normalise peak to -3 dBFS for editorial use.

game-asset-normalize.label: Game asset normalisation
game-asset-normalize.purpose: Consistent in-engine asset level with loopable, click-free edges.

archive-transfer.label: Archival transfer (measure-first, minimal processing)
archive-transfer.purpose: Preservation-safe: removes DC offset only. Sample-rate change is left as an explicit, separate step because resampling an archive master is a rights and provenance decision.

dialogue-cleanup.label: Dialogue cleanup for editorial
dialogue-cleanup.purpose: De-rumble and level dialogue without changing timing or tone decisions reserved for the mixer.
